title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E02 — Appalachian Vendetta
Once-friendly neighbors on a mountain road become sworn enemies after one family calls police about a theft -- violating the unspoken tradition of leaving authorities out of disputes; years of conflict finally culminate with shots fired.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E05 — Other People's Property
The mountain road between them fails to keep two long-time neighbors from tormenting each other; seemingly small events bring their decadeslong hostility to a bloody boil, and property lines become battle lines in a fight to the death.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E09 — Blood on the Lawn
A five-year relationship between neighbors falls apart when one borrows the other's lawnmower and supposedly returns it broken; camaraderie morphs into rage, threats, and physical violence until a bloody murder devastates the community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E11 — Under Surveillance
A man returns to his hometown after years away; he receives a warm welcome from the residents until the noise from a new neighbor's puppies turns him into a vengeful menace who goes to war with the entire community.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E06 — A Clockwork Killing
An apartment-dwelling family finds their peace and quiet shattered when a loud neighbor moves into the unit directly overhead; the conflict engulfs both sides resulting in flying fists, drawn weapons, and a man left bleeding out in the hallway.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S08 E01 — Blizzard of Blood
A single woman and her two young sons believe they have found a perfect new apartment, but their overbearing landlord and neighbor soon turns their idyllic situation into a living hell of arguments and intimidation that finally ends in bloodshed.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E01 — The Man in the Mirror
Two young men are shot dead in the middle of the night, and the only witness has no idea who the gunman is; Omaha PD detectives turn to digital forensics, hoping hidden data buried in the victims' cell phones can help track down the killer.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E03 — Digital Crumbs
When family man Ricky Saxton is found murdered, investigators turn to a forensic data specialist at the FBI to help locate a missing piece of the puzzle; a deleted snapshot buried deep within the data leads them to Ricky's killer.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E04 — The Dog Knows
When police find 64-year-old nurse Athena Valentiny brutally murdered in her home, investigators follow the digital trail her killer left behind; they cross-reference the digital evidence with surveillance video to reveal who took her life.

title: Caught in the Net
description:
S02 E06 — Monsters Are Real
After the murder of young mother Morgan Ashley Fox, investigators don't have much physical evidence; with numerous suspects in the frame, digital evidence reveals the secrets of a monster hiding in plain sight.

title: Body Cam
description:
S09 E04 — Fire and Fury
A man holds his child hostage in California; officers negotiate with him, but he sets the house on fire; in Florida, criminals break into a jewelry store; officers must catch them before they escape with over $70,000 worth of jewelry.

title: Body Cam
description:
S09 E05 — Fight, Flight or Flee
In Ohio, cops face a hostage situation with a fugitive willing to go to extremes; in Maryland, police catch armed robbers in the act, and they run from the law; in Indiana, police risk it all to save circus animals inside a burning truck.

title: Body Cam
description:
S08 E02 — Nowhere to Hide
In California, an argument in a bar leads to a hostage situation; in New Mexico, a shoplifter fires upon an officer before going on the run; in Wisconsin, a suspect disappears into the frozen wilderness after flipping his car.

title: Body Cam
description:
S09 E08 — Deadly Disappearance
In Oregon, a murder suspect flees from the courthouse sparking a manhunt; in Arizona, an art heist has officers reaching new heights.

title: Body Cam
description:
S08 E08 — He Shot Me!
In New Mexico, a female officer pulls over a truck, but when she approaches, shots ring out; in Ohio, officers surround a house where men take a victim at gunpoint, the suspects escape with a second hostage, and a full-scale manhunt ensues.

title: Body Cam
description:
S08 E01 — Race Against Time
In Wisconsin, a terrified woman wakes up in her car and finds a thief is stealing it, sparking a high-speed police pursuit; a home invasion in Utah turns into a fire rescue, when a man sets the house alight with the residents still inside.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E16 — Who Took Heather?
A 13-year-old girl goes missing, sending Kenda's city into a panic; just when investigators think they've got a handle on what is going on, a cryptic letter to the district attorney's office suggests that the girl isn't the only victim.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E06 — The Cage
Lt. Joe Kenda finds the bullet-ridden bodies of a middle-aged couple in a musty suburban house alongside the corpses of their two beloved pets; the case gets stuck in neutral until detectives discover an essential clue hidden behind a birdcage.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E03 — .357 Magnum
The murder of a popular teenager at a crowded house party sends Lt. Joe Kenda down a winding road paved with lies, misdirection and innuendo; detectives use blood evidence to solve the shooting death of a firearms enthusiast.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E20 — The Case That Haunts Me
A woman is found in the mountains, naked and covered in blood; Detective Joe Kenda's investigation leads him to uncover a world of violence and sexual fetishes, culminating in the most intense interrogation of his career.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E17 — The Shoelace Killer
Teenagers find a woman's corpse while attending a party on the outskirts of the city; detectives quickly determine that the victim was strangled with her own shoelace, but they struggle to identify her.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E14 — The Invisible Hand of Death
Two teenagers stumble upon a woman engulfed in flames, leaving detectives to wonder who was capable of this magnitude of cruelty; when a college student is strangled in his home, Lt. Joe Kenda must figure out which of his roommates is lying.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S09 E16 — Fall from Grace
Hikers come across the nude body of a man who has been bound and beaten to death; when the victim's checkered past comes to light, Joe Kenda must wade through a laundry list of potential suspects to find his killer.

Ann McDonald's wealthy husband, Rich, cares more about social status than her happiness; when she seeks solace in Al Braunberger's arms, it unleashes a side of Rich she's never seen before, trapping her in a deadly game.

Hard-working immigrant Gladys Ricart finds love on an N.Y. subway, and she is introduced to a lush world she's never imagined, but her plans for a dream wedding turn into a horrifying nightmare.

description:

A Miami couple's idyllic Bahamian voyage on a luxury charter boat turns haunting when the craft drifts near Cuba with the crew missing; bloodstains and a missing raft unravel a tale of dark secrets beneath the shimmering waters of paradise.

title: Fatal Destination
description:
S01 E03 — Missing in Myrtle Beach
A teenager's spring break getaway to Myrtle Beach turns into a mystery that grips the nation; sneaking off without her parents' permission, she vanishes into the night, leaving behind a trail of cryptic clues.

title: Fatal Destination
description:
S01 E02 — Where's Emily?
A Vermont anniversary trip turns dark as a romantic getaway unravels into secrets, violence, and a camper crime scene, exposing the fragile line between love and control.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S04 E11 — Sex, Lies and Secret Texts
When free-spirited bartender Cassie meets family-guy Brent, the spark is intense, but it is doomed to explode and end with the snuffing out of a bright light.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S04 E08 — The Harder They Fall
Tom and Juanita Richardson's second honeymoon ends with a deadly fall from a cliff overlooking Lake Superior.

title: Fatal Vows
description:
S04 E01 — You Only Die Once
When wild-child Kim falls for a paragon of stability, Frank, it is a case of opposites being attracted to each other, then their attraction turns fatal.

title: Fatal Vows

S04 E12 — Murder in the Cards
A blackjack habit leads to tragedy for Gary and Helen, landing one of them behind bars and the other six feet under.

description:

In 2011, a 10-month-old baby girl goes missing from her home in Kansas City, Mo., and her family fears she's been kidnapped by a drifter, only to be accused by the police of being responsible for her disappearance.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E07 — In the Name of Love
In Grand Prairie, Texas, a game of truth-or-dare leads to a startling confession in the 1995 shooting death of 16-year-old Adrianne Jones.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E10 — The Darkest of Nights
In Craig, Ala., townspeople are shocked when police discover the charred body of beloved mother and wife Lauri Waterman; people have no idea who would want to kill her, then an unlikely witness reveals a sordid story of secrets and lies.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E11 — Jeffrey MacDonald: The Accused
A brutal 1970 home invasion claims the lives of Army surgeon Jeffrey MacDonald's wife and daughters, leaving him the lone survivor; authorities doubt his story of murderous hippies and believe MacDonald committed the crime himself.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E09 — The Grim Sleeper
A lone survivor is the only witness who can help police track down a serial killer known as the Grim Sleeper preying on women in South Central Los Angeles; after decades of searching, police hone in on an unlikely suspect.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S01 E05 — Cabin 28: Horror in the Woods
In 1981, a woman and three teenagers are murdered in a cabin in the remote town of Keddie, Calif., and no one is ever brought to justice; now, new evidence may hold the key to finally cracking this case.

title: People Magazine Investigates
description:
S09 E07 — The Girl on the Bike
In 1972, 20-year-old Jody Loomis takes a late afternoon bike ride to visit her horse and never returns home. She turns up murdered in the woods, and her case baffles the local authorities.

Police in Charleston, South Carolina, use a camera network to catch a killer who gunned down a man in front of his girlfriend. In Utah, when a man snaps and turns on his own family, police use drones to hunt him down before there's another victim.

title: Real Time Crime
description:
S02 E03 — Where's Alissa
In Louisiana, a murder turns up on tape; police use surveillance video and social media to track down the killer; investigators solve a murder using video evidence to solve a puzzle and catch a killer before he flees the country.

title: Real Time Crime
description:
S02 E01 — Warpath
In Albany, New York, a camera catches a murder, and a Real Time Crime Center helps bring the killer to justice; in Ft. Worth, Texas, police use surveillance cameras to track down a gunman and stop a one-man crime wave.

title: Real Time Crime
description:

When a man is shot and killed on camera outside an Atlanta area hotel, police use license plate readers to solve the mystery; two Ft. Worth, Texas, men go on a robbery spree; investigators use a tiny detail to track them down.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S02 E01 — Friend in Greed
A couple finds their friend shot dead and calls 911; police uncover a trail of deceit; when a gunman kills a woman in a drive-by shooting, police learn the killer is closer to home than they imagined.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S02 E02 — The Sound of Fear
A daughter frantically calls 911 after gunmen tie her up and shoot her parents at home; a burglar brings new information to a man's supposed natural death.

title: 911: Did the Killer Call
description:
S02 E03 — The First Suspect
A woman vanishes, and her husband calls 911; months later, police find her badly beaten body and make him suspect no. 1; a strange noise in the background of a 911 call leads police to the true killer.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S07 E01 — Killer Chatroom
A college student seeks solace online when the pressures of life begin to mount; when she meets a young nurse in a chat room going through similar troubles, the pair strike up an unbreakable bond, but she may have placed her trust in the wrong hands.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S07 E06 — Tortured Hero
When a young Army veteran returns from war, his family is relieved to have him out of harm's way finally. But danger lurks closer to home when a brief encounter on a dating app leads to a devastating tragedy.

title: Web of Lies
description:
S07 E02 — I See You
A masked predator is harassing high school girls in New Hampshire and will not stop until they meet his demands.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E15 — The Graveyard Shift
Natasha Cournoyer, 37, disappears without a trace in Laval, Canada; as her friends and family struggle for answers, detectives must follow a stone-cold trail to uncover her final footsteps caught on surveillance cameras.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E12 — Life After Midnight
The body of 26-year-old Celina Peterson is found in an alley in the South Park neighborhood of Seattle; when police recover surveillance footage from across the neighborhood, they begin to unravel the truth behind her murder.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E02 — Run From the Scene
Disc jockey Ervin Holton is found shot dead on his friend's porch; with no witnesses, investigators spot cameras outside a nearby store pointing directly at the crime scene.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E13 — Happy Birthday to Drew
In Madison, Wis., Andrew Nesbitt is found murdered on his 46th birthday; with no witnesses, investigators turn to surveillance cameras in bars and taxi cabs and on street corners to track down his killer.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E07 — Goodnight Jessika
Twenty-seven-year-old Jessika Kalaher is found strangled in her car in Cedar Park, Texas; with Jessika's wallet and car keys missing, detectives turn to security cameras in the hope of finding out who killed her.

title: See No Evil
description:

In San Antonio, Christopher Duncan leaves his apartment never to return again; police have little to go on until surveillance footage offers up the possible identity of a dangerous killer.
